name: reelsaid
title: ReelSaid — Instagram Reels Transcript API
description: Transcribe Instagram Reels in the original language, with timed segments, subtitles, and metadata.
defaultMemoryMbytes: sources = get(input, 'startUrls.length', 0) + get(input, 'shortcodes.length', 0) + get(input, 'datasetItems.length', 0); collections = get(input, 'profiles.length', 0) + get(input, 'datasetId.length', 0) + get(input, 'resumeFromDatasetId.length', 0); max(256, 512 * min(1, max(0, sources - 1)), 2048 * min(1, floor(sources / 12)), 1024 * min(1, collections), 2048 * min(1, collections) * min(1, floor(get(input, 'maxResults', 12) / 12)))
